name: Rush To The Vet! 🐶
desc:
Oh no! A puppy just tumbled down the stairs. Every second counts! 🐶
Rush it to the vet... if you can make it through the line!
🚗 Race to the clinic through traffic
📋 Wait in the (very long) check-in line
🩺 Answer Dr. Woof's questions
🛋️ Hang out in the waiting room
❤️ Surgery time: hang in there, buddy!
🎁 Meet your saved pet: 16 pets to collect, from Common to Mythic!
🐾 Your pet follows you everywhere
⏩ In a hurry? Skip the line or skip the wait
😈 Or cause some chaos: Bonk, Bark and Squirrel!
🩺 Be The Vet and run the whole clinic yourself!

llm.loop: get an injured puppy -> race through traffic to the vet -> wait in line and answer questions -> surgery -> collect the saved pet
llm.objectives: save the pet and collect all 16 pets
llm.progression: pet collection common to mythic, playing as the vet
llm.instructions: rush the pet to the vet, wait, answer questions, collect pets
unique: monetized waiting line (skip line/skip time) plus troll products like Bonk and Squirrel
monetization_signals: ban hammer and gravity gun passes
llm.thumbnails: cartoon art of a girl hugging a puppy at the vet, 'SAVE THE PUP!' text
llm.complexity_notes: linear short scenes, queue system, pet followers
